about: Entries for the Automation Monitor dashboard (https://monitor.ravitejaknts.com). One entry per scheduled job, workflow or service. key: <machine>/<job> (machines: homelab, bloxodes-vps, stack127-vps, macbook-pro, macbook-air; job = cron run-job.sh name, systemd unit without .timer/.service, launchd label or T3 schedule title), github/<owner>/<repo>/<workflow file>, supabase/<function or pg_cron job>, or northflank/<job>. name: short plain name. group: the section it is listed under. about: one sentence on what it does, written for the owner. impact (optional): what breaks if it stops. records (optional): stats_job_runs.job_name values it writes. ignore_records: job names that are sub-steps of other jobs.

automations.name: Ad network site checks
automations.about: Every hour at minute 40, checks up to 1,000 publisher sites (their ads.txt and pages), sends changed rows to production, and refreshes the site counts in titles and headings. It steps aside while a bigger job runs.
automations.impact: Network pages stop gaining newly confirmed sites.

automations.name: Daily ad network counts
automations.about: Saves today's publisher counts for each ad network.

automations.name: Publisher platform and favicon
automations.about: Fills in each publisher's website platform and icon, and refreshes facts older than 30 days.

automations.name: Publisher domain age
automations.about: Looks up when new publisher domains were registered.

automations.name: ads.txt summaries
automations.about: Summarizes each publisher's ads.txt file for the network pages.

automations.name: Find new publishers
automations.about: Every Tuesday, reads the ad networks' official seller lists and adds new publisher domains to check.

automations.name: Publisher business names
automations.about: Every Wednesday, refreshes publisher and business names from the official seller lists.

automations.name: Publisher traffic groups
automations.about: On the 5th of each month, loads the latest Chrome traffic data (CrUX) to group publishers by size.

automations.name: Ad networks data backup (OVH)
automations.about: Makes a consistent daily copy of the ad networks database on the Stack127 VPS and keeps 7 copies.
automations.impact: Recent ad network data could be lost.

automations.name: Ad networks data backup (homelab)
automations.about: Backs up the old homelab copy of the ad networks database and keeps 7 copies. Kept until the move to OVH is confirmed.

automations.name: Find new publishers (old homelab job)
automations.about: The old homelab version of publisher discovery. Switched off after the move to OVH.

automations.name: Preview publisher discovery
automations.about: A manual dry run that previews new publisher domains without saving anything.

automations.name: Preview publisher checks
automations.about: A manual dry run that previews ad network checks without saving anything.

automations.name: Sort sites into niches
automations.about: Every Sunday at 06:00 UTC, an AI model sorts new publisher sites into topic niches and saves them to production.
automations.impact: New sites stay out of the niche pages.

automations.name: Find apps in install catalogs
automations.about: Every Sunday, looks for self-hostable apps in install catalogs such as app stores for home servers.

automations.name: Find apps in directories
automations.about: Once a month, looks for self-hostable apps in public directories.

automations.name: Find apps on GitHub
automations.about: Every day, searches GitHub for new self-hostable apps.

automations.name: Find apps in curated lists
automations.about: Every Sunday, reads maintained awesome-lists for new self-hostable apps.

automations.name: Refresh GitHub facts
automations.about: Twice a day, refreshes stars, releases and activity for apps hosted on GitHub.

automations.name: Refresh GitLab and Codeberg facts
automations.about: Every day, refreshes facts for apps hosted on GitLab and Codeberg.

automations.name: Collect technical details
automations.about: Every Monday, collects install methods, languages and other technical details for each app.

automations.name: Page cache worker
automations.about: Every 30 seconds on the OVH server, checks for changed pages, refreshes ad-network heading counts when their data changes, and starts a static page rebuild when edits are waiting.
automations.impact: Edits do not reach the live site.

automations.name: Cache maintenance
automations.about: Every hour at minute 17, checks cache health and starts a static page rebuild when page refreshes are overdue.

automations.name: Rebuild static pages
automations.about: Rebuilds the static Cloudflare pages when content edits are waiting. Started by the cache system or by hand.

automations.name: Pull request checks
automations.about: Runs the core tests and one full build on every pull request.

automations.name: Release to production
automations.about: Deploys merged code to the OVH server and Cloudflare, then confirms the live site runs the new commit.
automations.impact: Merged changes do not go live.

automations.name: Publish pages
automations.about: Publishes selected tool and directory pages to production.

automations.name: Database backup (OVH)
automations.about: Every day at 02:40 UTC, backs up the production database on the OVH server. A failure opens a GitHub issue.
automations.impact: Recent production data could be lost.

automations.name: Database backup copy (homelab)
automations.about: Every day at 03:10 UTC, copies the newest database backup from OVH to the homelab and keeps 7. It fails when the newest backup is over 36 hours old. A failure opens a GitHub issue.
automations.impact: No off-server copy of production data.

automations.name: Production health check
automations.about: Every 5 minutes, checks that the site, Dokploy, the image registry, Traefik and the Cloudflare-only firewall are all working.
automations.impact: An outage on the OVH server goes unnoticed.

automations.name: Cloudflare IP list refresh
automations.about: Every week, downloads Cloudflare's official IP ranges so the firewall only lets Cloudflare reach the server.

automations.name: Docker port firewall
automations.about: At startup, blocks public access to Docker ports except the ones that are allowed.

automations.name: Private Dokploy tunnel
automations.about: Keeps the Cloudflare tunnel that serves the private Dokploy dashboard open.

automations.name: DNS tools checks
automations.about: Runs the tests for the DNS tools library on every change.

automations.name: DNS tools live test
automations.about: Every Tuesday, runs the DNS tools against real DNS servers to catch breaking changes.

automations.name: DNS tools dependency updates
automations.about: GitHub's Dependabot opens pull requests for outdated packages.

automations.name: Basebuddy demo reset
automations.about: Every night, wipes and re-seeds the public Basebuddy demo so visitors start from clean sample data.

automations.name: Basebuddy GitHub traffic
automations.about: Every 6 hours, saves GitHub traffic numbers for the Basebuddy repository, because GitHub only keeps 14 days.

automations.name: Umami GitHub collector
automations.about: A container that sends GitHub traffic numbers to Umami analytics. It has been restarting in a loop.

automations.name: Share env files with worktrees
automations.about: Every 30 seconds, keeps stack127's private env files linked into every worktree on the homelab.
